name: CI Runner Trust Policy
description: CI runners have limited trust. Secrets are scoped. Builds are isolated per branch and PR.
purpose: Minimize the blast radius of a compromised CI runner by enforcing least-privilege secrets, per-branch isolation, and explicit trust boundaries for each build context.
acceptanceCriteria: CI runners operate with least-privilege: each job receives only the secrets it requires.
Secrets are scoped per environment (branch build, PR build, release build).
PR builds run isolated from secret credentials (no write access to release infrastructure).
Branch builds from forked repos have reduced trust and no access to production secrets.
Build isolation is verified (containers, network policies, filesystem isolation).
Runner trust levels are documented and auditable.
Policy violations trigger immediate alert and block the affected job.
